title: Can Your Morning Coffee Be HSA/FSA Eligible?
summary: Vivi Longevity Coffee+ may be HSA/FSA eligible for qualifying customers with a Letter of Medical Necessity. Here's how it works and how to check eligibility.
body_markdown:
October 30, 2026


### [How Firefly Recovery Grew HSA/FSA Revenue 3.3x With Flex](https://www.withflex.com/blog/firefly-recovery-hsa-fsa-growth-case-study)


Firefly Recovery partnered with Flex to make it easier for customers to use their HSA/FSA funds for training and travel recovery. Compared with its previous provider, the brand saw 3.3x the HSA/FSA revenue, 3.1x the HSA/FSA orders, and a 7% higher average order value.
